question: Positions with no reads at all do not appear in the mpileup output. What does that mean for the depth distribution you just plotted?

answers.answer: Sites with depth 0 are missing, so the plot only describes positions that were covered
answers.feedback: Correct — the uncovered part of the genome is invisible here.

question: At low sequencing depth, why are heterozygous sites the hardest to call correctly?

answers.answer: With few reads you may sample only one of the two alleles, so a heterozygote looks homozygous
answers.feedback: Correct — this is the central problem in low-depth sequencing.

answers.answer: Heterozygous sites have lower base qualities
answers.feedback: Base quality does not depend on genotype.

answers.answer: The reference genome is always heterozygous
answers.feedback: A reference is a single haploid sequence.

answers.answer: bwa refuses to map reads at heterozygous sites
